nodes.title: 打斗修复 high motion fix

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] 15秒，写实都市情感剧。年轻长发女子在出租车后排右侧，浅色日常上衣，前排副驾驶空座椅背虚化在左下。窗上细雨与霓虹反光，男子灰夹克只局部入画。她微笑轻咬下唇，女子 (S1) 对窗外说 <d>[Chinese] 就这样，不用送了。</d> 随后朝司机方向转头，说 <d>[Chinese] 司机，开车。</d> 一声细微啜泣漏出来，她轻轻呼气，仍撑住笑。车启动，身体随起步轻晃，窗外男子退向后方。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, 切到后排肩部以上略低机位近景，此后不再剪切。笑意先残留两秒，她小幅摇头、抿住嘴，想忍住，才渐渐红了眼眶。10秒左右稍仰头，视线偏向侧窗，呼吸变重。随后眼泪落下，肩膀收缩、低头，最后抬头放声哭出并抬手擦泪。保持同一人物、同一车厢与连续泪痕，结尾仍在呼吸和颤抖，无字幕。

overall_soundscape:
细雨打窗、发动机与湿路胎噪；对白、啜泣、吸鼻和衣袖擦脸声保留空间距离。

non_diegetic_music:
0至6秒无配乐；6秒后极轻钢琴进入，随后大提琴、弦乐逐步加厚，在最后哭泣爆发时达到峰值，无歌词。

3. Rear three-quarter shoulder detail: a tight camera arc catches the shoulder drawing back behind the turning head.
4. Locked floor-level foot detail: the grounded support foot braces, its raised heel pressing down firmly without taking a step.
5. Rear neck detail: a short upward tilt catches the nape stretching with the turn; stop below the back of the head, keeping the jaw and face excluded.

3-9s, shots 6-13. The coiled arm opens into a forceful sweep:
6. A signature upper-body detail: a fast diagonal slide catches an existing seam, joint or distinctive contour responding as the arm draws inward.
7. Elbow: a sharp lateral track catches the folding joint tightening the arm's coil.
8. Supporting knee: hard match cut from the bent elbow to the knee's similar angle; a short camera drop catches the leg compressing under the same preparation.
9. Wrist: a quick shallow orbit catches it turning outward to initiate the release.
10. Upper chest: a short punch-in catches the chest opening as the arm drives outward beyond the crop. Let this moving surface read slightly longer.

12. Upper back: a sharp sideways slide continues that screen direction as the shoulder rolls through the sweep and the torso twists.
13. A distinctive torso or waist detail: a close diagonal move catches its physical response to the twist, such as an existing fold pulling taut or an attached piece swinging. Give the material response a clear moving read.

9-13s, shots 14-19. One short step and a pivot build toward the reveal:
14. Thigh of the other leg: an abrupt low tracking move catches it driving the single short step out of the twist.
15. Advancing foot: a brief downward whip catches it landing; show clear floor contact.
16. Ankle and lower-leg detail: a fast side slide catches the landed leg accepting weight as the ankle flexes.
17. Waist: a tight orbit catches the torso rotating above the planted-foot pivot. The foot supports the turn rather than sliding across the floor.
18. Back-of-head contour: a short lateral whip catches the start of the return turn from behind. Keep only the rear contour in frame, never the facial profile.
19. A signature shoulder detail: a sharp diagonal slide catches its follow-through beneath the turning head, which stays completely above the crop. Cut at the peak of this movement.

13-15s, shot 20. First face reveal:
20. Hard cut to a frontal face close-up as the character sharply completes the turn toward the lens. An explosive short push reveals the entire face clearly for the first time and stops tightening before cropping out its features. Direct eye contact lands while hair, clothing or natural body follow-through remains alive. Keep the whole face readable through the end; finish on living motion, without a held pose or another cut.

No added props, scenery, text, graphic overlays or split screens.

Two distinct contacts erupt with blue-white light and orange sparks.

From three to six seconds, she pursues before his skid ends. Her high diagonal attack draws his high block; she disengages around its edge and changes into a low cut. He drops his blade to intercept. She uses that collision to spring her katana upward, forcing his arms apart. Each attack follows a different visible path. Water streams backward from their accelerating footwork.

From six to nine seconds, he interrupts with a straight thrust. She slips outside its line and knocks his blade outward with a short lateral parry. Closing immediately, she drives her sword hilt into his chest armor. He recoils, then whips a horizontal countercut toward her head. She folds beneath it while advancing and rises with a diagonal slash that he barely catches. Give the hilt impact and blade clash separate, sharply timed accents.

From nine to twelve seconds, he commits to a heavy overhead strike. She briefly supports her katana with her left hand, catches the blow on a steep angled guard and turns the bind sideways while sliding. Their blades scrape for an instant, shedding sparks. She releases into a short reverse cut; he blocks across his body. Her next rising beat kicks his sword high, exposing his chest. Their continuous travel brings them close to the sedan.

From twelve to thirteen seconds, enter a brief slow-motion charge. Her forward boot plants hard into the wet road; her hips coil and her katana draws beside her rear hip. Her coat sweeps forward from the sudden deceleration. Blue light compresses tightly along the blade into a brilliant concentrated edge. Rain beads catch its light. Keep the opponent visible directly ahead, recovering his raised sword. The camera creeps forward as rushing air drops into a tense pressure hum.

At thirteen seconds, snap abruptly back to extreme full speed. She releases her coiled body into one explosive forward diagonal slash. Show the blade meeting his attempted block, snapping his steel sword and continuing into his chest armor. A white-hot blue contact burst erupts, followed by luminous fragments and backward-streaming sparks.

The hit launches him bodily away: both feet leave the road, his torso folds around the impact, and he flies backward across the visible gap into the already-established sedan. Keep the strike, airborne trajectory and car collision visible in the same continuous shot. He slams into its side before fourteen seconds, deeply crushing the door, buckling the panel and bursting the side window. His body stops against the car while glass and water continue outward.

During the final second, he drops from the dented door onto the road. She finishes in a braking skid several steps away, katana extended, coat whipping past her body. The camera decelerates with her. Broken steel and glass land around the damaged car.

Make the inclined catch, low scoop, lateral parry, duck, two-handed interception and sliding blade bind visually distinct. Every defense redirects the next attack. Use brief motion smears between crisp contact drawings. Impact flashes originate exactly at contact, illuminate faces and rain, then clear immediately. Maintain the same side of the travel axis, consistent weapon ownership and accumulated damage. No cuts, location changes, standing resets, dialogue, captions or blood.

Relentless rushing air, heavy rain and directional water wakes. Each launch produces a sharp pressure crack. Distinguish glancing deflections with short metallic scrapes, hard blocks with bright cracks, the blade bind with a grinding hiss, and the hilt strike with a dry armor thump. During the final slow-motion charge, narrow the ambience beneath a rising blade-energy hum. At release, deliver a sharp air rupture, steel fracture and heavy armor impact, followed by the crushing car collision. End with falling glass, broken steel and rain.

non_diegetic_music:
An original instrumental electronic-rock score around 200 BPM, with driving breakbeats, rapid percussion, distorted bass and aggressive guitar accents. Build rhythmic density through the varied exchanges. During the final slow-motion charge, rapidly strip away the drums and compress the music into a rising low-frequency pulse. Leave a tiny silence immediately before release. The finishing contact triggers the strongest bass hit, followed by a crushing downbeat on the car collision. Let the score decay beneath falling glass and rain. Keep combat sounds prominent. No vocals.

Keep the performance restrained, like a tired colleague silently realizing something inconvenient. His mouth stays closed. Hold this quiet reaction for about one and a half seconds. She turns forward and drives the pickup toward screen left, its front still pointing left. The giant remains stationary for one beat as the departing pickup's dust reaches him. He blinks and slowly wipes his face with one broad hand. He then turns his head, shoulders, hips and feet toward screen left, aligning his whole body with the pickup's direction of travel. He rises and takes his first running step toward screen left. Complete the dialogue, dust reaction and turn before the cut.
